Title in English: Process for the production of pipeline parts from plastic and pipeline part produced by this process
Abstract in English: Plastic pipes based on unsaturated polyester resins have low molecular weight polyester units with free hydroxyl groups. These functional groups present in particular in the resin-rich inner layer part forming the inner wall of the pipe are chemical reaction centres which react with a very wide range of compounds, such as, for example, water, inorganic and organic acids and oxidizing agents. Thus, when the polyester pipes are used in drinking water pipelines, the components dissolved out of the polyester resin by the chemical reaction of the water and the free hydroxyl groups may have an adverse effect on the quality of the drinking water. The invention relates to a process for the production of pipeline parts from polyester resin, which in turn have increased water resistance. The process according to the invention is distinguished by the fact that at least the polyester layer forming the inner surface of the pipe is treated with a medium containing at least one isocyanate. This treatment does in fact result in the formation of a matrix having polyurethane groups, which in turn impart to the plastics pipe not only the desired water resistance but also increased strength and impact strength.

Title in English: AUTOMATIC SHUTTER FOR VENTILATING FANS
Abstract in English: An automatic shutter for ventilating fans is disclosed. The shutter has an openable plate, two magnets and a balance weight. The openable plate is hinged to the outlet of the fan by two hinge shafts, of which the position leans to the upper portion of the plate. The two magnets cooperate with wind pressure acting on the plate, thus allowing the plate to be selectively closed or opened in accordance with the operation of the fan. The balance weight is mounted to the upper portion of the plate, thus rendering the lower portion of the plate slightly heavier than the upper portion. In an embodiment, two permanent magnets, having opposite magnetic poles, are respectively mounted to the outlet of the fan and the openable plate at corresponding positions. In another embodiment, an electric magnet, in place of a permanent magnet, is interiorly mounted to the outlet of the fan and is operated in conjunctIon with the fan, thus selectively and momentarily generating a magnetic force having the same magnetic pole as that of the permanent magnet of the openable plate when the fan is turned on.

Title in English: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR CORRECTING EFFECTS OF SHIP MOTION IN MARINE SEISMOLOGY MEASUREMENTS
Abstract in English: An apparatus and method for removing the distortion in marine seismic data resulting from the motion of the ship. The ship trails one or more seismic sources and receivers and moves forward at a known velocity. The seismic sources emit seismic waves that travel through the water and reflect off interfaces between rock formations below the ocean floor. The motion of the sources and receivers introduces distortion in the recorded seismic data that can be modeled using Doppler theory The data preferably is corrected for source motion independently from the correction for receiver motion. The seismic data is first corrected for receiver motion and then for source motion. The technique for correcting for source motion includes correlating the receiver-corrected data with a reference sweep signal, performing an F-K transform, performing an inverse F-K transform on a selected subset of the F-K transformed data, and computing appropriate correction filters for the data resulting from the inverse F-K transform. This process is repeated for all subsets of F-K transformed data and the resulting filtered data are summed together.

Abstract in English: A method of encapsulating hazardous waste materials including heavy metals such as arsenic, mercury, nickel and chromium residues, as well as radioactive materials. Tests conducted on the encapsulated material indicate that virtually none of the hazardous waste material is leached out of the set composition which has a concrete-like appearance.

Title in English: Casting Steel Strip
Abstract in English: In twin roll casting of steel strip, molten steel is introduced into the nip 16B between parallel casting rolls (16) to create casting pool (30) supported on casting surfaces (16A) of the rolls and the rolls are rotated to deliver solidified strip (20) downwardly from the nip. Casting surfaces (16A) are textured by a random pattern of discrete projections having pointed peaks and the strip is moved away from the casting pool at a speed of more than 60 meters per minute. In order to suppress chatter defects, the molten steel has a manganese content of less than 0.6% by weight and a silicon content in the range of 0.1 to 0.35% by weight. The random texture may be produced by grit blasting the casting surfaces on a substrate covered by a protective coating. Alternatively the texture may be produced by chemical deposition or electrodeposition of a coating onto a substrate to form the casting surfaces.

Title in English: SYSTEM FOR THE CONTACTLESS RECOGNITION OF HAND AND FINGER LINES
Abstract in English: A process for reproducing hand and/or finger lines with a camera works without skin contact with the recording device. By using linearly or circularly polarized light in the paths of the illuminating and the reproducing light rays it is possible to obtain separate representations of the pattern of the epidermis and the one of the hypodermis. An image of the relief of the skin that is rich in contrast is obtained in this way, on the one hand, and it is possible to acquire information from the deeper disposed layers of the skin already supplied with blood. An algorithm searches the skin patterns of the palm of the hand for line elements of different strengths and directions (vectors). The computed numerical identification contains overall frequencies of vectors as well as amplitudes and phases of frequency components of projections of the vector images of both patterns. The process permits controlling people from a distance, complete protection of the measuring system and enhanced security against fraud

Title in English: Turbine, Particularly Useful for small Aircraft
Abstract in English: A turbine essentially comprises a mechanical generating system including a combustion chamber (2) providing useful mechanical work on a high-speed shaft (8), a speed step-down system (22-23) for receiving rotational energy from the high-speed shaft and an output system including a low-speed shaft (24) receiving rotational energy from the speed step-down system for delivering mechanical from the turbine to a load. Auxiliary systems are kept to a minimum for lubrication, control, operation and start-up functions, thereby making the turbine particularly attractive for light aircraft. The combustion chamber is designed with deflectors (29) generating vortices in a secondary gas flow into the combustion chamber, thereby confining the flame front from penetrating into the cold region (3) of the chamber under variable operating conditions, simplifying cooling of the chamber walls. The highhspeed shaft is cantilever mounted on a pair of bearings (9A-9B) in the cold region and is provided with a longitudinal duct and an array of fine orifices (18) in the wall of the shaft which direct pressurized oil in the duct in the form of jets which impinge on the bearings with little relative speed, thereby increasing wetting of the bearing components. Oil is supplied to the duct by means of a positive-displacement pump (25) directly driven by the shaft. The output pressure of the pump provides a signal which is indicative of turbine speed and hence used to control the turbine start-up sequence. The turbine further includes devices for deecoupling vibrations between the three systems thereof, including a loosely mounted spline (16) coupling the high-speed shaft to the step-down system and disk dampening means (32) coupling the step-down system to the low-speed output shaft.

Title in English: A NOVEL APPROACH TO MODERATE WEATHER CONDITIONS BY EXPLOITING HEAT PIPE TECHNIQUE
Abstract in English: This work investigates a novel passive, environmentally friendly and very cost-effective technique to control/moderate the outdoor weather of hot climate regions that are nearby a large body of water. Large heat pipes (Fig.3) immersed into huge body of water are used to absorb heat from the surrounding a1r and release it into the water. The resulting temperature differences enhance the created pressure gradient between the land and water, which in turn accelerates the air movement (wind) from high to low pressure and therefore enhances the onshore breeze. Weather changes in a certain coastal area would have a positive reflection on its vicinity and to certain extent to the climate change and storm prevention. A certain number of large heat pipes can be immersed into water body. The evaporator section (1) is exposed to the surrounding ambient, while the condenser section (5) is immersed in the water. The evaporator section will be heated up by the effect of high surrounding temperature. This heat will be dissipated through the condenser section to the sea/river by the heat pipe process. As a result, the surrounding ambient temperature will be lessened and a higher pressure cooler air in the vicinity of the heat pips will be created. This high pressure air will strengthen the sea-breeze.

Title in English: A Novel Design of Cooling Tower with Superior Performance and independent ofgeographical location with Lower Initial & Operating Costs
Abstract in English: The size and cost of the cooling tower are increase with increasing heat load. The height of an evaporative cooling tower is usually limited by practical considerations such as structural strength, expense or architectural form. Wet bulb temperature is an important factor in performance of evaporative water cooling equipment, because it is the lowest temperature to which water can be cooled. This work investigates a new design of cooling tower, which independent of ambient condition or geographical location. The main principle is based on using one of the open-to-sky OTS shafts of multi-story building/s as a Body of the cooling tower and exploiting the exhausted cold foul air of the air-conditioned spaces as part of the induced draft air and as a condenser of the evaporation losses. To lessen/eliminate the high required demand power in pumping the hot water to higher elevation, an adequate vertical axis turbine is installed on the top of the cooling tower through ductwork as a source power. The proposed design concentrates on lowering the construction and operating costs, Lessening the makeup water and maximizing the heat load capacity, particularly in hot humid climate. Meanwhile, most of the limitations and constraints of the cooling towers have been overcome.

Title in English: Glass Fiber Reinforced Plastic Pipes Encased in Reinforced Concrete
Abstract in English: Glass fiber reinforced plastic (GRP) pipes are widely used throughout the world for various applications. They can be manufactured in several ways and in accordance with different international specifications to suite each application. For underground pipe networks however, there are two methods of installation: a) Open-cut installation in which a trench is dug in the ground and the pipes laid out and connected together in the trench, and b) Micro tunneling in which the pipes are fed and continuously pushed (Jacked: hence called jacking pipes) behind a micro-tunneling/boring machine from one point to the other. Method a) is typically used for shallow networks in soft soil conditions while method b) is applicable to deep lines and in rock soils. The most widely used jacking pipes in the world are the reinforced concrete pipes (lined or unlined), other types of jacking pipes used are carbon steel and GRP pipes. For sewer lines in general however, it is important for the used pipe to have essential properties: 1) The inside surface of the pipe shall be smooth to facilitate the flow of sewer effluents, 2) the pipe shall be able to resist the chemically severe conditions resulting from the chemicals in the effluents, its temperature, and humidity, 3) Sufficiently strong to withstand the pressure forces resulting from the surrounding soil, and 4) economically competitive. Reinforced concrete only pipes can fulfill points (3) and (4) above, while GRP fulfills points (1) and (2). It is possible to manufacture GRP pipes that can fulfill points (1), (2), and (3) above and work as a jacking pipe, but then it will have to be too thick and therefore very expensive. Therefore, these new pipes (GRP pipes Encased in Reinforced Concrete) were invented to meet all the requirements of Jacking pipes).

Because of the softness of the plastic bag and the movements of the vehicle, the lower half of the kandora often ends up fallen at the feet area and gets crumpled. As a solution, Double Hanger adds an extra hanging trait to the regular hanger and enables it to lift the whole kandora smoothly.

Title in English: Nonintrusive inspection method and system of cargo type objects: vehicles, container trucks, train carriages
Abstract in English: The present invention consists of a method and a scanning system for the nonintrusive inspection of vehicles, container trucks and train carriages. The inspection can be realized without direct human intervention upon the inspected object, thus eliminating time wasting activities like physical control, unsealing, etc. The proposed method for nonintrusive inspection of vehicles and containers has a high inspection capacity (up to 200 vehicles per hour), by achieving a complete vehicle radiography (except the driver’s cabin), while driving through the scanning portal and building a system that implements this method, said system being geometrically optimized so that it can be transported rapidly in ISO standardized containers using conventional transport systems (airplane, ship, train, or terrestrial on public roads) in areas where a high level of security is mandatory. The system which implements the method presented earlier is constituted from a mobile scanning unit installed on a chassis 1, said chassis provided with a boom 3 that displays areas of detectors 10 specifically chosen according to the type of penetrant radiation used. In transport mode, the boom 3 is folded which assures the minimum gauge that would allow the compliance of the vehicle with the authorized dimensions of public road transport or in fitting the system into an ISO high cube standardized container. In scanning mode, the boom extends and takes an upside down “U” shape, sustaining at its inferior end, parallel with the detectors area 10 plan, the penetrant radiation source 9. The scanning system also includes a mobile control center which is positioned outside the exclusion area a and has the role to remotely command all the processes involved in the nonintrusive inspection. The mobile control center has an acquisition, processing, storage and image display subsystem 22. The scanning system includes a perimeter protection subsystem 32 and an automated traffic management subsystem 36.

Title in English: Gravity Driven Generator for Sustainable Movement. (GDGSM)
Abstract in English: The innovation in this invention, is the method by which we use the force, created by the interaction of the gravitational field upon different elements (liquids, gases, solids), to produce electrical energy. Humanity has used the force of gravity for a long time in water and air driven turbines for electricity production. But in those technologies, the force used, is the one created by the gravitational field in the particular element, and once this element gives away its energy, it continues its movement and cannot be used in the same turbine again. In the gravity driven generator for sustainable movement (GDGSM), in order to create rotation force we use the fact that elements with different atomic weight, are subjected to different forces, while, exposed to gravity field. In the gravity driven generator for unsustainable movement (GDGSM) we use the difference in the force created between air (gas) and the liquid element to create a buoyant force, which through the solid element to be able to perform work. This is the main difference between the 2 types of technology as mentioned above. In conventional technology we have 1 element which gives its energy, and it the gravity driven generator for sustainable movement (GDGSM) we have 3 elements interacting, creating buoyant force which than perform work.

Title in English: Composite Groynes - Timber logs fixed to steel tubular piles
Abstract in English: Groynes are structures perpendicular or almost perpendicular to the coastline. Groynes are widely used to protect the coastline against erosion caused by littoral drift. Traditionally, groynes are constructed using rocks, but other materials like timber, steel and concrete are also used. Compared to the rock groynes, the timber groynes are preferred due to its aesthetic and natural appearance, less footprint and thus less disturbance to the coastal processes and environment. However, till date the use of timber logs in groyne construction is limited to shallow depths due to the non-availability of longer lengths of logs with uniform cross-section. This led to the current concept of composite groynes, where the timber logs are fixed to continuously driven steel tubular piles. The timber logs are plugged through the fresh concrete, partially filled inside steel piles and the gap between the successive timber logs is filled with concrete to form an impermeable groyne. For aesthetic reasons, the top of steel piles has been fixed lower than the Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT), in this case 0.5m below LAT, so that the steel piles are not visible at all tidal conditions. As the steel tubular piles can be fabricated to any desired length, the proposed composite groynes are applicable for any given water depth.

Title in English: Novel Selective medium for Gram negative bacteria.
Abstract in English: Bacterial species are broadly classified into two groups based upon their staining characteristics i.e. Gram positive organisms and Gram negative organisms. These classification is the first step in identification and characterization of bacterial species isolated from environment or from clinical samples. Although, many commercially available media are viable, there is a continuous effort to develop better selective media to bacteria that cannot be grown on existing media. While exploring antibacterial property of a plant products, we observed that it has the potential to selectively inhibit growth of certain types of bacteria. This lead us to do the experiments which resulted in developing this media which selectively allowed the growth of only Gram negative bacteria. Mueller Hinton Agar (MHA) was used as the base media and was modified to develop MHA-X (MHA containing the plant product, which we designate as plant-X). Water extract of 25 % (W / V) plant X material was used and added to the MHA to prepare the new media which was designated as MHA-X25. Number of strains of several medically important major Gram negative pathogens were tested; which included Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Salmonella spp. and Pseudomonas aeruginosa and observed that all these bacterial species grew on MHA-X25. However, none of the major types of Gram positive pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Streptococcus pyogenes, Bacillus spp. and Enterococcus spp. grew on MHA-X25. Taken together, these findings show that MHA-X25 is a newly developed selective media for culture of Gram negative bacteria.

Title in English: Automatic Recognition of Plastic (3D-printed) threat in Baggage X-rays using Artificial Intelligence
Abstract in English: Full specification: In this page, the 3 novel innovations will be discussed in more details. 1- Innovation in creating a full 3D-printed threat x-ray image dataset: a. The innovation lies in the fact that data collection of plastic x-ray images was collected in a systematic and scientific way, not by randomly screening the baggage that contain the threat as it is in the scientific papers. This was as follows: i. Collecting x-ray images of the plastic threat being alone in the baggage without any other material so that the algorithm starts to learn the features of the gun without any noises from external objects. ii. Then collecting additional images of x-rays, but this time we add some organic materials in addition with the plastic threat (orange colors in x-ray) to mimic the colors of the plastic threat. This way the algorithm will start to note the difference in terms of shape too and it will no longer get fooled from the organic materials. iii. Finally, collection of baggage x-ray images that mimic that baggage of a normal passenger. That means the baggage must include both metallic and non-metallic materials, complex mixtures were made in addition to the plastic threat being hidden in the bag so that the algorithm generalize its knowledge to real life scenarios. 2- Innovation in Threat Image Projection technique: to create new synthetic images from original images that appear authentic to increase the dataset: a. There are other approaches for threat image projection, which is the projection of a threat from one image to another normal image to multiply the number of threat images, however some of these techniques are not very accurate. This means that new image will have cues that appear to be fake and that can be dangerous to the algorithm. b. The technique of (Solving Poisson equations with a predefined boundary condition) is an accurate technique as I have seen and makes the x-ray projection to be authentic. Title in English: Granulated Date Kernel Herbal Tea with/without Natural Color with Complete, Transparent, and Easy Liquor Extraction
Abstract in English: Date kernel is one of the most valuable plant wastes in the food industry. Given its high nutritional value for humans, the need to design a mechanism for its introduction into the global food chain and its mass industrial production is strongly felt. Granulated date kernel herbal tea is a product that has managed to introduce a way to public use and mass production. This herbal tea is consumed like tea and only requires boiling water and 3-4 minutes of brewing. In this method, the hard and solid date kernel (roasted or not-roasted) is powdered to allow liquor extraction of all kernel particles in boiling water. However, transforming the kernel into powder is not sufficient to make it consumable. Due to the particles' dispersion and molecular weight, the powder stays afloat in water and its extracted liquor will contain solid particles, which accordingly causes non-transparency and poor quality of the extracted liquor. By adding a sedimentation (or translucent) agent to the kernel powder, the extracted liquor becomes clear and transparent. Shaping and granulizing of the powder will be possible by adding a natural binding agent. Moreover, with the addition of natural edible colors to this blend, a transparent extract of various colors could be obtained, though its original color may vary from light yellow to dark yellow. After mixing the above ingredients and converting the powder into paste by adding water, the processes of shaping and changing the paste into granular particles and drying are then executed. Title in English: Solar water brine recycling and evaporation system for production of water, salts and minerals.
Abstract in English: Abstract Solar water brine recycling and evaporation system for production of water, salts and minerals. The system is based on parabolic-cylindrical reflectors (concentrators), and a closed evaporation pond with a cover to speed up the evaporation process. The pond is connected to condensation storage unit which also acts as a heat exchanger. The brine is heated to 120-125 ° C, at a pressure of 0.2-0.25 MPa and enters the evaporator of a special design, where evaporation occurs at atmospheric pressure and separation of the crystallized sediment occurs. The sediment is then divided into salt, minerals and metals. The parabolic evaporation system has individual protection of the reflective surface in the form of shockproof glass. The system recycles reject water (brine), produces clean water, salt, minerals and metals. It significantly reduces the installation cost and reduces maintenance costs. The system also takes less space than traditional evaporation systems.

Title in English: Hitech Mechanical Ventilator
Abstract in English: ABSTRACT The aim of this project is to develop a smart Intensive Care Unit (ICU) mechanical ventilator which applies artificial intelligence principle to support COVID19 infected patients since it is mandatory to isolate them, while the doctor and caretaker can monitor remotely. The pressure in the air and oxygen supply line in the ICU is controlled to deliver an FiO2 mix from an air-oxygen blender to the patient during inhalations, and remains idle during exhalations. Exhaled gases are released by the patient himself limited by PEEP control valve and End Tidal CO2 sensor senses the CO2 in the exhaust. The blood oxygen saturation level of the patient is measured using an infrared pulse-oxygen probe, and FiO2 auto-regulator controller applies the 6th sense and changes the FiO2 level based on the oxygen saturation level. FiO2 auto-regulator has an oxygen and air blender to control the oxygen-air mix proportion. A pressure sensor and flow sensor are provided at the inlet airway to the patient and their signals trigger the pressure relief valve if limit is exceeded. In case of any AC power failure, the backup battery system will start functioning automatically with an alarm indication for power source change and battery charge level. Artificial Intelligence is used on a windows platform for Machine Learning to provide alerts and display the vital parameters of patients based on threshold values and recommend actions. The mobile application assists the doctors and care takers to monitor the patient remotely.

Title in English: WATER REJUVENATION DEVICE
Abstract in English: A waterbody rejuvenation device (100) includes a flow inlet (102), a coarse sieve (104), a finer sieve (105), a pump (106), a submersible motor (108), a multi-phase multi-stage flow multiplier (MMFM) (110), floats (202a and 202b), a basket filter (115), an air/dosing intake (116) and an air/dosing valve (116A). The flow inlet (102) draws laden water with suspended organic and inorganic impurities including one or more of algae, floating debris, suspended solids, and settled sludge with petrified organic material, turbidity fine dust present in a water body. The coarse sieve (104) filters coarse dirt and debris from the received laden water. The finer sieve (105) further filters a portion of the laden water entering the pump (106), that has filtered through the coarse sieve (105). The pump (106) draws and pressurizes the laden water. The submersible motor (108) provides mechanical power to the pump (106). The MMFM (110) inducts and adds additional fluid flow at every stage of the laden water with suspended solids and gaseous fluids, thus increasing the total flow rate in addition to the pump flow rate that is handled for filtering or separating suspended solids and/or aerating the fluid passing through the MMFM (110). The floats (202a and 202b) facilitate the levels of the waterbody rejuvenation device (100). The basket filter (115) receives the fluid exiting from the MMFM (110) and collects and further filters the finer suspended solids in the fluid before returning into the water body. The air/dosing intake (116) and an air/dosing valve (116A) inducts one or more of air from the atmosphere and/ or ozone, Hydrogen Peroxide, Sodium Hypochlorite, and oxidizing agents, herbicides from the source connected to the air-dosing intake (116) by the MMFM (110).

Title in English: EARLY DETECTION SYSTEM FOR RED PALM WEEVILE (RPW) USING AI & MACHINE LEARNING
Abstract in English: The red palm weevil (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus Olivier) is the worst pests for palm trees in the United Arab Emirates and Gulf State Region in particular, and wherever there are palm trees available in the world in general. When the infestation with this insect is discovered, usually it is too late for recovering the plant. The goal of this work was to develop whether RPW pest in palm trees could be detected at an early stage by monitoring the sound produced by the larvae while chewing and boring and the smell present inside the infested trees from the first day of hatching. Normalized gas, sound, temperature and humidity sensor signals, infected trees odor and sound samples were separately and simultaneously processed using semiconductor sensors algorithm techniques. With normalized gas and sound with the temperature and humidity samples, RPW infected palms could be distinguished from the healthy ones. The performance of classification models are based on RPW infestation whatever the number of larvae, whereas those based on the treatment samples are collected. This new device demonstrates that the technology has great potential for use as an effective RPW early stage pest monitoring method. Two types of Palm devices. 1. Palm ECG device - similar to human body ECG concept. It is used for testing the Palm Trees if infected; if not two sensors are inserted at the bottom and at the middle or top of the trees for real time testing, 2. Palm Guard - this is a small sensing device to be kept in the Palm Trees to protect the trees from any attack that might occur by newborn larvae in the future after we make sure that the Palm Trees are not infected after testing using the Palm ECG. Both these systems use the same sensing technology with AI & ML attached inside the Palm trees to detect the new born larvae, starting from 1st or 2nd week in the early stage, the only difference is that the Palm ECG has multiple wires and has with or without wireless communication module to send messaging and to be removed immediately after the Palm Tree test. The 4-in-1 MEMS device sensor: The 4-in-1 technology digital Micro-Electromechanical System (MEMS) device sensor and four methods of detection which uses odor, sound, temperature and humidity sensors in one device to identify and detect the RPW in real time. The device is programmed by Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Machine Learning (ML) electronic digital gas and sound MEMS sensors adapted to the same gases produced by the larvae to capture the natural odor from one side of the device and sound sensor on the other side of the device, and to detect the noise of the larvae while chewing and boring hole that had already been learned by AI & ML. The tip of the device’s enclosure has an opening for air and sound to pass through the device. The method for sound and odor detection is by placing the gas and sound sensor device inside the trees about 15cm to 30cm, if needed, to be able to identify and recognize the odor if the palm tree is healthy or infected and to detect a similar sound produced by the larvae while chewing in the early stage. The 4-in-1 digital device detection system will give alert or notification to the palm owner once there is a detection of larvae noise or infected odor; and the red LED light of the device will remain blinking to identify the infected Palm Trees, sending wireless communication protocol alert to the concerned Authority. The system also includes Temperature and Humidity digital MEMS that works with odor and sound sensors which presents a comprehensive check-up to the Palm Tree. An infected palm has a different temperature and humidity inside the palm tree body which is learned by AI and ML. This unpresented AI & ML low cost solution, using dual MEMS as Hidden Enemy Detector (HED) for RPW early detection from day one of manifestation, will solve the threat and challenges which had been long time affecting the Palm Trees and other related trees like Canary, Coconut and Oil Palms, which affects the farmers and the countries food security, and will disappear forever by applying this real time monitoring system.

Title in English: Production of Modified Hexakis Melamine Crosslinker Resin (Methoxy Methyl) to Enhance Paint and Coating Products Features
Abstract in English: Hexakis (methoxy methyl) Melamine Resin can be used as an effective crosslinking agent among hydroxyl, carboxyl and amino-functional groups of the polymer, due to the presence of reactive functional groups. It’s an important methylated melamine formaldehyde grade, and suitable for mixing with alkyds, polyesters, acrylics, epoxies, urethanes, etc. Low hydroxymethyl content in Hexakis Melamine Resin and its high extent of alkylation and low tendency to self-condense makes this product a highly effective crosslinking agent for a broad range of applications such as wood, automotive, appliances, coil, paints, lacquers, printing inks, etc. In this invention, we made melamine modified resin with enhanced qualities by fundamental changes in the resin manufacturing process (pH, temperature, time, molar ratio, etc.) and used 5 types of glycolic modifier additives (DEG, PEG, PPG, PG and 1,3-Butanediol). Due to polar and reactive functional groups of glycolic compounds, principled, optimal hexamethylolation and etherification conditions, a large number of active methoxy and ethoxy groups have been created in its chemical structure. This reactive groups cause the resin tendency to interact and create strong cross-link by alkyds, polyesters, acrylics, epoxy, urethanes, etc. and enhanced the properties of the resin and improves thermal resistance, chemical resistance, solvent resistance, corrosion resistance, weather resistance, acid and alkali resistance. To identify the properties of the modified Hexakis Melamine Resin, viscosity, free formaldehyde content, color measurement (gardener), solid content, density, rheological behavior, acid resistance, alkaline resistance, salt spray, MEK rub and etc. tests were done on the modified melamine resin and combination of this with saturated polyesters. The result of tests demonstrated that application of 5 types of glycolic modifier additives and engineering changes in reaction conditions, was one of the key reasons for improvement of the characteristics and affected the morphology of the resin, and it tends to crosslink during the reaction with the resin by increasing the reactive functional groups on the melamine resin chains during forming. With the increase of polar functional groups (such as polyester), coatings with better physical, chemical, thermal properties and etc. were created.

Title in English: Design Self-reinforced 3D Concrete Printing mixture using local UAE materials
Abstract in English: The fourth industrial revolution has crossed the threshold of the construction sector by introducing machinery capable of implementing construction tasks, and this auto-manufacturing process is called 3D Concrete Printing (3DCP). It reduces waste, time, workforce, and the ability to design complex projects due to the absence of formwork. The key point for a successful 3D printing process is the right selection of printing materials. Earlier research has shown that the brittleness, weakness of the concrete against tension, and the need for adding reinforcement (steel) are the main characteristics affecting the widespread of this technology. This disclosure aims to develop a new mix design suitable for the 3D concrete printing process capable to be used for different structure applications, strong against tension and shows a tensile strain-hardening behavior and ductile failure behavior similar to metal rather than the brittleness behavior of the normal concrete under applied load. In addition, this developed construction material can reduce or eliminate the use of reinforcement in the printed structure which is the main challenge affecting the widespread of 3D printing technology in the construction sector. Moreover, all projects printed in GCC countries, especially UAE depend on imported construction materials from foreign countries which can lead to an increase in the cost and affect the progress of 3D concrete printing technology to reach the vision of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum to ensure that 25 % of buildings in Dubai are based on 3D printing technology by 2030, so to overcome this obstacle this developed construction material is mainly based on locally available material in UAE which can reduce the cost and the need to import material. In addition, can promote the name of UAE higher in the 3D Concrete Printing sector.

Title in English: Manufacture of Animal feed from Date Palm waste
Abstract in English: Manufacture of Animal feed from Date Palm waste Abstract According to Food and Agriculture Organization Corporate Statistical Database (FAOSTAT), the estimation of the tonnage of date palm grove waste in the UAE is around 122,000 Tons. The accumulation of these free resources is generating harmful environmental effects. Many are burned to get rid of. In Hence, I found it feasible to develop a sustainable production system for conversion and utilization of date palm waste and fronds in order to recycle and transform them into organic animal fodder. Procedures Collect the waste of date palm leaves that are pruned from date palm farms, transport it to a processing facility. Then crush it using a chipper grinder to reduce size less than 2 cm, then grind it again using a hammer mill to reduce size less than 1 cm. A quality testing and dust removal is performed to confirm the safe use as an animal feed ingredient. A steaming process takes place with certain added value ingredient (formula) and then pelletized to sizes ranging from 4 to 8 mm. Then bagged and transported to animal feed distributing centers and ready for animal use. The process from chipping to bagging is an integrated automated system using conveyors to reduce the cost of manpower. Advantages of crushed Date Palm Leaf and the added value to animal feed: • Excellent source of dry matter for livestock feeding. • Excellent source of fiber. Can replace Hay, straw, etc up to a certain extent in ration. • Extensively grown in Arab countries, around 77% of world production according to FAOSTAT. • Available throughout the year. • A method of waste management, recycling and environmental friendly. Compliant with Abu Dhabi Environment vision 2030. • Contributes to reduction of environmental pollution by preventing the burning of palm waste. • Sustainable solution. Compliant with UAE Vision For Sustainability Development. • Reduce dependency on animal feed imports thereby adding In Country Value to the UAE economy. • Keeps pace with the national strategy for food security in the UAE and supports the need of local food production. • The Nutritional components and the price point of the product combined makes it an excellent value for animal feed. Proof of Concept A Pilot Plant was set up in Alain, Abu Dhabi, UAE to analyse feasibility of the project. After POC, the manufacture is currently working with a production line capacity of more than 300 Tons per month of crushed date palm leaf. We have supplied more than 200 ton of this material to feed companies and the usage of this product is on a rise.The feed was tested, approved, and supplied to one of the largest companies producing and distributing animal feed in the UAE. A patant application for this technology is also in process. As we add value to a resource which usually ends up in landfills , this project will attract the respect of visionary leaders of the country and its citizens.

Title in English: A new concept of operation (CONOPS) for the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled autonomous and electrically powered push-back / tow tractors at the airports.
Abstract in English: Inventor/New Concept Developer: Efgan Dengür SPECIFICATION Title: A new concept of operation (CONOPS) for the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled autonomous and electrically powered push-back / tow tractors at the airports. Abstract: The aviation industry is striving to reduce carbon emissions from airline operations. While advancements in airplane engine designs and the use of low-carbon fuels, such as biofuels, have contributed to improved fuel efficiency and reduced emissions, achieving the desired levels remains a challenge. To further enhance fuel efficiency and minimize emissions, research is focusing on optimizing ground operations in addition to in-flight processes. This new concept of operation (CONOPS) addresses the critical pre-takeoff and post-landing ground segments by utilizing AI-enabled, fully autonomous, and electrically powered push-back and tow tractors (TUGs) to manage aircraft movements with engines off. This innovative approach, with its distinctive features of full autonomy, real-time coordination, enhanced environmental efficiency, advanced navigation, and operational flexibility, addresses the limitations of existing technologies such as those described in JP 2013-224144 A and US 6305484 B1. It provides a robust solution for reducing carbon emissions and improving efficiency in airport ground operations, establishing a significant advancement over prior art. Key Distinctive Features: 1. Full Autonomy with Advanced AI Integration: • Unlike previous patents, such as JP 2013-224144 A and US 6305484 B1, which describe semi-autonomous or manually controlled systems, our AI-controlled TUGs operate fully autonomously. This involves AI-driven decision-making and task execution, eliminating the need for human intervention from the pool area to the aircraft and back. 2. Real-Time Coordination with Air Traffic Control (ATC): • Our TUGs seamlessly integrate with ATC systems, allowing for real-time task assignment and dynamic response to operational changes. This ensures optimal coordination and efficient use of resources, a feature not evident in previous patents that lack real-time adaptability. 3. Enhanced Environmental Efficiency: • By towing aircraft with engines off, our system significantly reduces fuel consumption and carbon emissions during ground operations. This approach not only meets but exceeds environmental standards by leveraging AI to maximize operational efficiency and sustainability. 4. Advanced Navigation and Safety Features: • Equipped with LIDAR, cameras, and sophisticated navigation algorithms, our TUGs ensure precise movement and obstacle avoidance. This advanced navigation capability ensures safety and reliability, even in complex airport environments, surpassing the simpler force sensor-based systems in previous patents. 5. Operational Efficiency and Flexibility: • Our TUGs autonomously disconnect from the aircraft upon task completion and return to the pool, ready for the next assignment. This operational flexibility minimizes turnaround times and enhances overall airport efficiency, offering a level of operational efficiency not provided by prior technologies. Specific Operational Steps: • Pre-takeoff operations: After passenger boarding, the AI-controlled TUG autonomously connects to the aircraft and tows it from the gate to the engine start-up point, typically 3-5 minutes before takeoff. • Post-landing operations: After the aircraft lands and vacates the runway, the TUG autonomously connects and tows the aircraft to its assigned gate. • Operational cycle: Once the TUG completes its task, it autonomously disconnects from the aircraft and returns to the pool, ready for the next assignment from ATC.

Title in English: Method For Inducing Active Immune Tolerance By Generating A Vaccine From Autoreactive Apoptotic T Cell Clones
Abstract in English: The present invention proposes inducing long-lasting active immune tolerance by generating a vaccine derived from autoreactive T clones that have been induced to undergo apoptosis in the framework of specific autoimmune diseases. Type 1 Diabetes mellitus (T1DM) is chosen as the organ-specific autoimmune disorder, which has been chosen to carry out the proof of concept. However, this method can be used to develop similar vaccines for other autoimmune diseases. For the sake of achieving it, refers to a Human Leukocyte Antigens (HLA) selection methodology to choose the highest frequency of HLA-I and HLA-II in the United Arab Emirates population related to T1DM as well as a methodology for the selection of epitopes of pancreatic antigens to present. It includes the extraction method of autoreactive T clones from T1DM donors specific to the selected pancreatic epitopes and immunology characterization of isolated cell populations from diabetes patients, as well as the assessment of the autoreactive lymphocytes’ proliferative capacity against pancreatic cell lines by flow cytometry. The present invention relates photosensitization/ photoactivation methods that will be performed in expanded autoreactive T clones selected for the generation of an apoptotic cell vaccine. The present invention is also related to the assessment of cellular immune response in vitro induced through apoptotic cells when placed in contact with peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) autologous and allogeneic from patients suffering from T1DM using mass cytometry. In addition, the present invention proposes to mix clones of non-autologous autoreactive T cells (“multi-clones”) like components of the innovative apoptotic autoreactive T cell vaccine. It also refers to a proposal for vaccine pharmaceutical form, its injectable preparation and methods of administration thereof. The generation of an immune response capable of inducing tolerance through apoptotic cells in a scenario of autoimmunity constitutes the basis for the following in vivo preclinical studies and for future productive scaling of an apoptotic autoreactive T cell vaccine.

Title in English: wireless energy transmission
Abstract in English: This project endeavors to create a leap forward in the world of wireless energy transmission, by not only working towards efficient point-to-point transmission but also by introducing an innovative approach - Multi Node Asynchronous Distribution. This holistic approach focuses on simulating the transmission of energy in various scenarios using Python, encompassing concepts of electromagnetism, quantum physics, and complex algorithms. We embarked on this journey by designing software models for point-to-point and multi-node wireless energy transmission. The models aimed to simulate different aspects of wireless energy transmission including aspects such as transmission power, efficiency, and the effect of various environmental factors. The software utilized a GUI-based approach for inputting various parameters such as voltage, current, type, size and the number of turns of the transmitter/receiver coils, the distance between the coils, and the presence of magnetic materials. With these simulations, we intended to provide insight into photon trajectory, spread, energy distribution, and more, delivering rich data for further analysis. We ensured that our simulator is capable of delivering high performance, by establishing benchmarks for speed, memory usage, and scalability. Our study takes into account the intriguing behavior of photons in space and on Earth, and how this behavior impacts wireless energy transmission. It integrates quantum physics and the unique nature of photons, integral to understanding their interaction with magnetic fields and their role in energy transmission. To analyze this behavior, we deployed mathematical models, generating three different perspectives: understanding behavior in space, on Earth, and the difference between the two. This helped us analyze, for instance, how the effect of gravity impacts the speed and trajectory of photons and thus impacts wireless energy transmission. As we ventured into the quantum realm, we elucidated the definition of quantum and quantum computing, as well as their significance in comprehending photon behavior. This perspective is important as quantum physics allows us to understand the particle-wave duality of photons, giving us insights into their energy, momentum, and interaction with magnetic fields. In terms of global advances, we took note of the efforts being made by space agencies and their interests in the field of wireless energy transmission, quantum physics, and the potential use of this technology in space exploration and communication. In closing, this project endeavored to leverage the power of simulation and mathematical modeling to better understand and enhance wireless energy transmission. Our efforts have taken us across diverse fields from electromagnetism to quantum physics and have shown promising potential in revolutionizing wireless energy transmission for the future. Conclusion and Invitation In conclusion, our work on this project has left us with no doubt about the real-life applicability of our findings. From our comprehensive simulations to our mathematical models, every aspect of our research indicates that our innovations in wireless energy transmission, particularly Multi Node Asynchronous Distribution, can have real-world implications and applications. The power of this technology could profoundly impact not only energy sector but also space exploration, telecommunications, and numerous other domains. However, as profound as our findings are, the project's scope and the potential of the technology are too vast to be fully encapsulated within this executive summary. Therefore, we strongly encourage the reader to delve into the attached white paper. The document provides a more detailed, comprehensive understanding of our methodology, simulations, and findings. It includes in-depth information on our work, backed by scientific references, and a thorough exploration of the mathematical models that we used to understand the behavior of photons in different environments. We are excited to share our work with you and look forward to the next steps in this exciting journey of innovation in wireless energy transmission.

Title in English: Sustainable power generating jetty
Abstract in English: The present invention is a floating jetty designed to generate electricity by efficiently harnessing tidal energy. The system operates by converting the natural movement of water into kinetic energy that rotates turbine blades, the turbine rotates a shaft fitted with flexible blades made of piezoelectric material which have the property of generating an electrical charge when they undergo mechanical stress or deformation. The shaft is located within a specially designed convergent-divergent nozzle located at the lower part of the jetty. This nozzle serves to increase the velocity of water flow as it passes through, optimizing the energy capture process. Each side of the nozzle features two steel frames, these steel frames hold two turbines on each side of the nozzle, these turbines are attached to a shaft. The turbine blades are secured to the shaft using nuts, ensuring structural stability during operation. The shaft has at least six flexible blades, each fabricated from piezoelectric material. These flexible blades are engineered to bend and flex when their tips come into contact with steel bars mounted on the nozzle’s surface. The flexing action of the blades generates mechanical strain, which in turn produces electrical energy through the piezoelectric effect. The nozzle is fitted with at least twelve strategically placed steel bars, distributed along its top and bottom surfaces. These bars play a critical role in enhancing the creating a mechanical stress and vibration that induces electric charge from the piezoelectric material of the flexible blades.

Title in English: MindPlay
Abstract in English: MindPlay is a non-invasive, home-based product-service system designed to deliver personalized neurofeedback therapy and remote monitoring for children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). The system integrates a paediatric electroencephalography (EEG) headset, camera-based eye tracking, and an engaging therapeutic videogame called Sugar Rush to provide continuous brain training and symptom management. Neural concentration metrics, derived from the beta-to-theta EEG power ratio, dynamically modulate the game speed, while real-time gaze direction controls navigation. Session data are securely streamed to a cloud platform where game difficulty is personalized and analytics are generated for access via a caregiver and clinician mobile application. The child-centred EEG headset is co-designed for comfort and engagement, and the game visuals are developed from children’s own artwork to foster identity and sustained adherence. By combining brain-computer interface and eye-tracking technologies, MindPlay offers a safe, medication-free, cost-effective alternative to traditional ADHD treatments, enabling objective progress tracking and reducing the need for frequent clinical visits.

Title in English: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR GENERATING GEOCODES FOR ADDRESSES
Abstract in English: The present disclosure discloses a system and method for generating one or more geocodes for addresses. The system receives at least one text input address having one or more attributes. The system removes pre-defined words and characters from the received address and generates a cleansed address. The system converts the generated cleansed address into a token, and further converts the token into embedding with a pre-defined dimension. The system learns the embedding on address data with the pre-defined embedding dimension and a pre-defined sequence length. The system computes a plurality of grids of pre-determined resolution based on pre-determined available geocodes and generates an output as a centroid of the pre-determined resolution of the computed grid. The system analyzes probabilities of the generated output and determines proximity of nearby addresses. The system groups the centroids of one or more addresses having highest cumulative probability and predicts at least one grid of the pre-determined resolution from the computed grids based on the determined proximity. The system further generates a geocode of the predicted grid for the generated cleansed address. Relevant Figure: Figure 2

Title in English: Insulation by nanomaterials for the prevention of biodegradation in plastic pipes (antibacterial plastic pipes)
Abstract in English: Recently, several researchers have assessed the migration of organic chemical compounds (OCCs) from plastic pipes, especially unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) and high-density polyethylene (HDPE). Last year, research conducted on an aged distribution network using plastic pipes (uPVC) revealed the main reason for contaminants migration is the biodegradation of the pipe material due to the formation of a heavy biofilm on the inner surface of the uPVC pipes resulted in the migration of the poly aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) into the drinking water associated with high concentrations of trihalomethanes, total organic carbon, especially near the dead ends. The International Agency for Research on Cancer classifies some PAHs as known, possibly, or probably carcinogenic to humans. Therefore, plastic pipes (uPVC and HDPE) need protection or change in the manufacturing processes to prevent biodegradation of the pipe material in distribution networks over time. The main idea of the present invention is to prevent biofilm formation on the pipe surface, protect the pipe material from biodegradation, and subsequently prevent the migration and leaching of organic chemical compounds from the pipe into the drinking water by using nanomaterials insulation on the inner pipe surface.

Title in English: Method and system for quantum control of the Casimir force
Abstract in English: In this work, we investigate the coherent control of the Casimir force (CF) in a four-level atomic system under electromagnetically induced chirality. Therefore, we consider two parallel slabs of finite length in a quantum vacuum composed of ensembles of cesium vapor atoms in a four-level double A-type atomic configuration. By the use of the quantum interference (QI) effect which arises from the cross-coupling between the different spontaneous emission pathways, we demonstrate that it is possible to fully control the CF in the system via the spontaneously generated coherence (SGC) and the relative phase between the electromagnetic fields. In fact, we first show that the chirality in the atomic system can be induced by the SGC and the probe detuning, satisfying the passivity conditions. Next, we manipulate and control the QI in the system by changing the angle between the dipole moments, as the SGC is sensitive to their relative orientations. Besides, we explore the dependence of the Casimir interaction energy on the relative phase of the control fields. Finally, we observe that the Casimir interaction energy can be switched from negative to positive for a specific given phase value.

Title in English: Invent a new smart tooth notation system ( Al Shekhli smart tooth notation system)
Abstract in English: Al Shekhli smart tooth notation system This system can be considered as a smart modification for the Zsigmondy/Palmer notation system and can be also considered as the 4th international tooth notation system or UAE smart tooth notation system. The code for each tooth is composed of one letter either U or L representing the upper jaw or lower jaw respectively and another letter (deciduous teeth) or number (permanent teeth) representing the tooth in each quadrant similarly in Zsigmondy/Palmer notation system (1-8 for permanent teeth or A-E for deciduous teeth). If the number (1-8 for permanent dentition) or letter (A-E for deciduous) dentition, comes on the right side of the letters U or L, then it represents the left side of the jaw while if it comes on the left side of the letters U or L then it represents the right side of the jaw. For example, 1U is the upper (maxillary) right permanent central incisor while U1 is the upper (maxillary) left permanent central incisor, L8 is the lower (mandibular) left permanent wisdom (3rd molar) tooth while 8L is the lower (mandibular) right permanent wisdom (3rd molar) tooth, AU is the upper (maxillary) right deciduous central incisor and LE is the lower (mandibular) left 2nd deciduous molar tooth. Supernumerary teeth in the primary and permanent dentitions are identified by the placement of the letter "S" following the letter or the number identifying the adjacent primary or permanent tooth respectively (for example, supernumerary "UAS "is adjacent to" UA " maxillary left deciduous central incisor tooth ; supernumerary "LES" is adjacent to "LE " mandibular left 2nd deciduous molar tooth). supernumerary "U1S "is adjacent to" U1 " maxillary left permanent central incisor tooth ; supernumerary "L8S" is adjacent to "L8 " mandibular left permanent 3rd molar tooth

Title in English: SHISHA FILTER CONTAINING ACTIVATED CARBON AND SAP
Abstract in English: Abstract: The present invention relates to an independent, shisha smoke detoxifying filter. The filter named SMOKLEAR is a two-stage filter cartridge designed to actively remove significant amount of the hazardous chemicals, particulates/nanoparticles, Carbon monoxide, nicotine, tar, dissolved toxin, and water vapors from the shisha smoke. The present invention relates to a new Shisha filter, in which the combination of Pellet Activated Carbon and Non-Toxic Super Absorbent Polymers (SAP) beads are used that have not been applied in Shisha filter before. It accomplishes this by passing the shisha smoke through a bed of pellet activated carbon followed by a bed of non-toxic Super Absorbent Polymers. The activated carbon selected for this invention has a lattice of tiny pores within the carbon pallets with vastly increased surface area. The increased surface area allows the smoke molecules to pass through the carbon bed and have extended contact time with the activated carbon in order for toxic substances to get adsorbed and trapped on the surface of activated carbon and create an effective filter medium. The shisha smoke molecules then travel to the second stage filter and pass through a bed of non-toxic SAP (Super Absorbent Polymers) beads, where trapped moisture and toxic vapors are actively removed. This is achieved by non-toxic Super Absorbent Polymers absorbing the trapped moisture and toxic vapors from the smoke. The process by which SMOKLEAR shisha filter removes toxic substances from shisha smoke is known as adsorption process. During the adsorption process the toxic substances from shisha smoke stick to the outside of the activated carbon pellets. The increased surface area in the type of activated carbon selected in this invention gives the shisha smoke the possibility to have extended contact time within the activated carbon bed and for the toxic substances to stick to carbon bed effectively. Similarly, once the smoke molecules travel up to the second stage filter and passes through the non-toxic Super Absorbent Polymers, the trapped moister and vapors get absorbed by the Super Absorbent Polymers. Once the activated carbon and Super Absorbent Polymers beads are saturated the filter effectiveness in trapping toxic substances from shisha smoke gradually reduces. SMOKLEAR shisha filter cartridge is designed as a one-time use or disposable type. The cartridge size and the amount of activated carbon and Super Absorbent Polymers used in each cartridge is carefully selected and tested in the laboratory under ISO (International Organization for Standards) test methods. The filter is designed to perform effectively during one long shisha smoking session lasting up to three hours. After which the filter cartridge should be replaced in order for filter to maintain its effectiveness.

Title in English: A Product for the Bioremediation of Marine Crude Oil Spills in the Coasts of Abu Dhabi
Abstract in English: The present invention relates to a bioremediation composition designed for the degradation of crude oil in marine environments. The formulation consists of a bacterial blend (15%) suspended in a carrier medium formulated to mimic the exact composition of natural seawater near the coasts of Abu Dhabi. The bacterial consortium, comprising Prauserella soli , Chelatococcus sp. , and Marinobacter nauticus in a 1:1:1 ratio, has been evolutionarily engineered for efficient hydrocarbon degradation in the Arabian Gulf. The composition is applied directly to oil-contaminated marine environments after dilution, facilitating rapid microbial colonization and oil breakdown. The bioremediation process achieves up to 95% crude oil degradation within 30 days. The formulation is designed for stability, with a shelf-life of up to twelve months under cold storage conditions. This invention provides a sustainable and effective alternative for mitigating the impact the petrol industry in the region.

Title in English: THREADED JOINT FOR STEEL PIPES FOR THE SURFACE TREATMENT THEREOF
Abstract in English: This invention relates to a threaded joint for steel pipes which comprises a pin and a box each having a contact surface including a threaded portion and an unthreaded metal contact portion and which can be prevented from galling during repeated fastening and loosening without application of compound grease. A solid lubricating coating which comprises a lubricating powder such as molybdenum disulfide and a resin binder is formed on the contact surface of at least one of the pin and the box. The coating is formed by applying a coating fluid and drying the applied coating by first stage heating in the temperature range of 70 °C to 150 °C and second stage heating in the range of from higher than 150 °C to 380 °C. The resulting solid lubricant coating has a hardness of 70 – 140 on the Rockwell M scale and an adhesive strength of at least 500 N/m as determined by the SAICAS (Surface And Interfacial Cutting Analysis System) method, and it exhibits excellent galling resistance even in the environment of high-temperature oil wells. Inclusion of ultraviolet screening fine particles such as titanium oxide fine particles in the solid lubricant coating increases the rust preventing properties of the threaded joint.

Title in English: REVERSE ACTING RUPTURE DISC WITH LASER-DEFINED ELECTROPOLISHED LINE OF WEAKNESS AND METHOD OF FORMING THE LINE OF WEAKNESS
Abstract in English: A reverse acting rupture disc is provided having a laser defined electropolished line- of- weakness recess, and an improved method of forming an electropolished line-of- weakness recess in a reverse acting rupture disc that assures full opening of the disc upon reversal. A rupture disc blank is pre-bulged, final bulged, and then provided with a layer of resist material. A laser is used to remove at least a portion of the layer of resist material corresponding to a desired line-of-weakness recess in the concave face of the bulged rupture disc. The disc is then subjected to an electropolishing operation to remove metal from the lased area of the rupture disc, thereby forming a lustrous polished line-of-weakness recess in the disc of desired configuration and of a predetermined depth that is related to material thickness. The electropolished line of weakness is defined by spaced opposed channel portions separated by a central raised crown portion wherein the channel portions are of greater depth than the crown portion. The burst/reversal pressure of the disc having an electropolished line-of-weakness recess may be selectively controlled by varying the pre- bulging pressure on the disc.

Title in English: TREATMENT PROCESS FOR CONCRETE
Abstract in English: A single anode system used in multiple electrochemical treatments to control steel corrosion in concrete comprises a sacrificial metal that is capable of supporting high impressed anode current densities with an impressed current anode connection detail and a porous embedding material containing an electrolyte. Initially current is driven from the sacrificial metal (1) to the steel (10) using a power source (5) converting oxygen and water (14) into hydroxyl ions (15) on the steel and drawing chloride ions (16) into the porous material (2) around the anode such that corroding sites are moved from the steel to the anode restoring steel passivity and activating the anode. Cathodic prevention is then applied. This is preferably sacrificial cathodic prevention that is applied by disconnecting the power source and connecting the activated sacrificial anode directly to the steel.

Title in English: AUCTION METHOD AND SERVER
Abstract in English: The present invention relates to an auction server and method in which bidders can enter into bidding for a product with bids ranging from a minimum price for the product submitted by a seller to a maximum price for the product, thus enabling the seller and the bidders to autonomously determine the price of the product, and the successful bid amount of the lowest successful bidder is applied as the asking price for all the successful bidders, thus benefiting both the seller and the successful bidders. The auction method according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a step in which the auction server maintains a database containing, for a particular product, the maximum price, the minimum price submitted by the seller and the number of products for successful bidding; a step in which the auction server receives, from the bidders, bid information containing bid amounts for the particular product ranging from the minimum price to the maximum price; a step in which, if a pre-set bidding time has elapsed, the auction server compares the number of products for successful bidding and the bid information, and thus can select the lowest successful bidder from among the bidders; and a step in which, on the basis of the bid information for the lowest successful bidder, the auction server applies the successful bid amount of the lowest successful bidder as the asking price for all of the successful bidders, and requests payment.

Title in English: PROCESSING OF AUDIO SIGNALS DURING HIGH FREQUENCY RECONSTRUCTION

Title in English: IMPROVED PATIENT EMERGENCY RESPONSE SYSTEM
Abstract in English: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

Title in English: A DELAYED RELEASE DRUG FORMULATION
Abstract in English: Delayed release of a drug to the colon is achieved from a delayed release formulation comprising a core and a coating for the core. The core comprises a drug and the coating comprises an inner layer and an outer layer. The outer layer comprises a mixture of a first polymeric material which is susceptible to attack by colonic bacteria, and a second polymeric material which has a pH threshold at about pH 5 or above. The inner layer comprises a third polymeric material which is soluble in intestinal fluid or gastrointestinal fluid, said third polymeric material being selected from an at least partially neutralised polycarboxylic acid and a non-ionic polymer. In embodiments in which the third polymeric material is a non-ionic polymer, the inner layer comprises at least one of a buffer agent and a base. Advantages of formulations according to the present invention include accelerated release of the drug when exposed to colonic conditions and reduction or elimination of a food and/or alcohol effect on drug release after administration.

Title in English: ACCURATE QUANTIFICATION OF FETAL DNA FRACTION BY SHALLOW-DEPTH SEQUENCING OF MATERNAL PLASMA DNA
Abstract in English: Embodiments of the present invention provide methods, systems, and apparatus for deducing the fetal DNA fraction in maternal plasma without using paternal or fetal genotypes. Maternal genotype information may be obtained from a maternal-only DNA sample or may be assumed from shallow-depth sequencing of a biological sample having both maternal and fetal DNA molecules. Because sequencing may be at shallow depths, a locus may have only few reads and may fail to exhibit a non-maternal allele even if a non-maternal allele is present. However, normalized parameters that characterize non-maternal alleles sequenced can be used to provide an accurate estimate of the fetal DNA fraction, even if the amount of non-maternal alleles is in error. Methods described herein may not need high-depth sequencing or enrichment of specific regions. As a result, these methods can be integrated into widely used non-invasive prenatal testing and other diagnostics.

Abstract in English: An electrostatic spray dryer for drying liquid into powder including an elongated body defining a drying chamber, a spray nozzle assembly at one end of the drying chamber and a filter element housing and powder collection chamber at an opposite end. Title in English: ENVIRONMENT-FRIENDLY MARINE FUEL
Abstract in English: For the shipping industry, these fuels provide solutions to long outstanding technical problems that heretofore hindered supply of low sulfur marine fuels in quantities needed to meet worldwide sulfur reduction goals. Marine shipping use of high sulfur bunker oils is reported as largest source of world-wide transportation SOx emissions. When ships on the open seas burn cheap low grade heavy bunker oils high in sulfur, nitrogen and metals, the SOx, NOx, and metal oxides go to the environment. This invention converts essentially all of each barrel of crude feed to a single ultraclean fuel versus conventional refining where crude feed is cut into many pieces, and each piece is sent down a separate market path meeting various different product specifications. When in port, ships can use these fuels to generate and sell electricity to land based electrical grids to offset fuel cost in an environment-friendly manner.

Abstract in English: A heat transfer system that includes one or more heat exchangers and one or more control pumps that control flow through the heat exchangers. In order to source a variable load, the control pumps can be controlled to operate at less than full duty flow. In an example embodiment, a controller can calculate, when each heat exchanger is clean, coefficient values of each respective heat exchanger. The controller can determine, during real-time operation, real-time coefficient values of the heat exchanger to compare with the respective coefficient values when clean, in order to determine whether there is fouling in that heat exchanger. In some examples, the controller can determine that maintenance is required on the heat exchanger due to the fouling, and perform flushing of the heat exchanger by operating one or more of the control pumps at full duty load during real-time operation to source the variable load.

Title in English: A MONITORING SYSTEM FOR CABLE, PIPE OR WIRE TRANSITS, AND A TRANSIT GUARD UNIT FOR USE THEREIN
Abstract in English: Disclosed is a monitoring system (2) for cable, pipe or wire transits (1; 1a…1n) of a type which has a plurality of transit elements (10, 20, 30, 40; 42; 400) to be assembled into a sealed installation of one or more cables (2), pipes or wires at a site (5). Each transit (1; 1a…1n) has a transit guard unit (50; 50a-50n; 150; 250; 350; 450) configured to detect a condition indicative of whether the installation of the cables, pipes or wires in the transit is sealed or at least potentially not sealed. A central monitoring unit (70) is configured to receive, over a communication network (60; 60b), first information (110, 112) about the condition detected by the transit guard unit (50) of any of the transits (1a…1n). The central monitoring unit (70) registers the particular transit (1a) as being in a first state (GREEN) when the received first information (110) indicates that the installation of the cables, pipes or wires in the transit is sealed, or as being in a second state (RED) when the received first information (112) indicates that the installation is at least potentially not sealed. While the particular transit (1a) is in the second state (RED), the central monitoring unit (70) receives second information (114) about the condition detected by the transit guard unit (50a) of the particular transit (1a). If the received second information indicates that the installation of the cables, pipes or wires in the transit is sealed, then the registered state of the particular transit (1a) is changed to a third state (YELLOW). The central monitoring unit (70) makes the registered states (GREEN, RED, YELLOW) of the respective transits (1a-1n) available to a user (3, 4) of the monitoring system (2).

Title in English: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR HIGH EFFICIENCY FILTERING AND REMOVAL OF AIRBORNE PATHOGENS FROM A VOLUME OF GAS
Abstract in English: A system and method for removing unwanted particles and pathogens, including but not limited to viruses, from a volume of gas. The system exhibits low resistance to air flow, allowing a high volume flow and rate of gas volume to be processed. Cold surfaces reduce the temperature of incoming gas causing condensation of water from the gas. The condensate contains unwanted particles and pathogens that have been removed from the volume of gas. The condensate is caused to pass over heated surfaces that comprising a hydrophobic coating, and also comprising catalytic surfaces with anti-viral coatings to neutralize contagions. Micro- spray nozzles, which may incorporate ionization, may be utilized to spray collected water onto the heated surfaces where the contagion may be neutralized. The system may comprise multiple stages. The system provides better contagion neutralization and higher flow rates than prior art systems while using less energy, and producing less noise.

Title in English: A BOTTOM HOLE ASSEMBLY
Abstract in English: Methods and apparatus for releasing a downhole tool of a BHA from a whipstock in a wellbore include a latch release mechanism disposed on a whipstock. The latch release mechanism has a latch actuator and a latch member. The latch actuator has a switch and an actuator piston disposed in housing having an inlet. Abstract in English: A floating drift apparatus for verifying the inner diameter of tubulars as the tubulars are made up into a tubular string being run into a wellbore. A float section provides buoyancy to float the apparatus in fluid within the bore of a tubular, and a drift section has a drift element with a diameter substantially equal to the tubular inner diameter being verified, which may be the drift diameter. When running a tubular string, the apparatus is inserted into the bore of the tubular string, floating in the fluid. As joints of tubular are made up and run into the wellbore, the tubulars move downhole around the apparatus. Preferably, the floating drift apparatus can be visually detected. If an undersize ID is encountered, the floating drift apparatus will be pushed downhole and no longer visible; the operator can remove the undersize ID tubular from the string.

Title in English: INTEGRATION OF HIGH FREQUENCY AUDIO RECONSTRUCTION TECHNIQUES
Abstract in English: A method for decoding an encoded audio bitstream is disclosed. The method includes receiving the encoded audio bitstream and decoding the audio data to generate a decoded lowband audio signal. The method further includes extracting high frequency reconstruction metadata and filtering the decoded lowband audio signal with an analysis filterbank to generate a filtered lowband audio signal. The method also includes extracting a flag indicating whether either spectral translation or harmonic transposition is to be performed on the audio data and regenerating a highband portion of the audio signal using the filtered lowband audio signal and the high frequency reconstruction metadata in accordance with the flag. The high frequency regeneration is performed as a post-processing operation with a delay of 3010 samples per audio channel.
